text_block_list.text:
One day, Daiichi Ruby suddenly paused in 
front of a flyer that read, "Umamusume 
Extreme Spicy King Deciding Match."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...The event is scheduled for today, and 
participants are still being recruited, is 
that right?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I have always felt that my weakness 
toward spicy food is a challenge I must 
overcome."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The quantity and sensitivity of TRPV1 
receptors are genetically determined. 
However, studies show that frequent 
stimulation can lead to desensitization."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
In other words, spiciness is something 
that can be overcome through accumulated 
experience.

"...That being said, it wasn't that she 
couldn't tolerate it at all; she seemed to 
have no trouble with regular meals, as far 
as I recall."
choice_data_list:
You don't have to force yourself to 
overcome it, though...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—If one bears the weight of our clan, one 
must always maintain the composure 
expected of them.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
During dinner, caught off guard by the 
spice... I end up making a terribly 
ungraceful display of myself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If there is even the slightest possibility 
of that, it should be eliminated 
beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
There are no mandatory events in the 
coming days. I believe today would be the 
optimal day for spicy food training.

To be honest, suddenly eating a large 
amount of unfamiliar food isn't good for 
the body. On the other hand, I also want 
to honor her feelings.
choice_data_list: Try to persuade them to stop

text_block_list.text:
And so, we promptly headed over to the 
venue where the competition was taking 
place.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha ha ha! Invincible, invincible, 
invincible, invincibleee! Turbo is the 
spicy champion once again!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A total of 13 participants. The rules are 
simple: the first one to finish eating 
wins, correct?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo can totally handle super spicy food! 
In fact, I love it! That's why I'm gonna 
win!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...She is the one to keep an eye on. Here 
I come.

And so, the "Umamusume Spicy Food 
Championship" began!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: S-Spicyyy! Water, water, waaaater~~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...gh... No, this much is nothing—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! So delicious, delicious, delicious, 
delicious!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I-I can't take this anymooore~~~!

Amidst the fierce battle unfolding, the 
only ones who could hold onto their 
chopsticks to the end were Twin Turbo and 
Daiichi Ruby—!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Ahahahahaha!?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

Daiichi Ruby had brilliantly seized 
victory for herself!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"The New Spicy Queen," is it? I seem to 
have received quite an unusual title.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I am deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ... A little hydration, first...

Thinking their mouth must be stinging, I 
handed over the honey yogurt drink I had 
bought beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, capsaicin is fat-soluble. 
Yogurt is a rational choice."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ............ That hadn't crossed my mind.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Sweet...

It turned out to be a day where I felt 
like I had caught a glimpse of a new side 
to Daiichi Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ………… Just one more bite—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aaaate it aaaaaallll!!

Just one step short...! Regrettably, the 
result was 2nd place!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for the match today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"To think they could eat a dish with this 
Scoville rating with such utter 
delight..."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I saw potential in an Umamusume's TRPV1.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, you weren't half bad either! Even 
though you're super elegant, you were 
fast!

She lost, but she managed to finish every 
bite! I hope that someday she'll be fine 
with spicy food... and I want to continue 
watching over her challenges.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
... I see, so they are concerned about the 
health hazards.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. The risk of gastritis 
and stomach ulcers, rising blood 
pressure...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, let us defer to your opinion as 
the expert."

And so, we decided to pass on the 
"Umamusume Spicy Food Championship."
